summary: FV-7 Safety Gap Closure Sprint — backend pytest (test_fv7_safety_gaps.py) → 15 passed, 5 skipped (all skips are deterministic seed-data guards: no Trench Box in roster has rated_depth_ft populated; no Road Plate seed has dimensions). Frontend smoke verified on /trench-safety/excavation/new (Emergency Excavation block present in Section 1, no JS errors) and /admin/trench-safety/excavations (both chip rows render with correct live counts matching /oversight-chips API). Backend chip endpoints, competent-persons endpoint, rated-depth acknowledgement endpoint, and public reinspection-request endpoint (no-auth, all 7 directive reasons) all verified green via direct curl + parametrized pytest cases.

minor.issue: Seed Trench Box rows in preview have rated_depth_ft=null on all 15 rows — FV-7.1 rated-depth flag tests skip in this env (4 tests). The deterministic flag rule is verified by code-path inspection in compute_osha_flags but cannot fire on real seed data. Consider seeding at least one trench box with rated_depth_ft for end-to-end regression.

Seed Road Plate rows do not carry dimensions.length_ft / dimensions.width_ft → FV-7.4 ROAD_PLATE_DIMENSION rule cannot fire on real records (test skips). Recommend backfilling plate dimensions on at least one seed asset.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking a chip on /admin/trench-safety/excavations does NOT update the URL with ?chip=<key> — filter appears to be in-memory React state (list refreshes via /excavations?chip=...). This is functionally fine per directive (single-tap filter) and the backend chip= filter is verified via direct GET. Note: deep-link / shareable URL not supported.

action_items: Optional: seed one Trench Box with rated_depth_ft populated and one Road Plate with dimensions to remove the 5 deterministic test skips and exercise FV-7.1 / FV-7.4 flag rules end-to-end against live data.
Optional (nice-to-have): wire chip selection into URL search params on ExcavationOversight so superintendents can bookmark / share filtered views.
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 gap closures are deterministic and observable. compute_osha_flags emits TRENCH_BOX_DEPTH at Action Required and downgrades to Needs Review when rated_depth_acknowledged && (reason || tabulated_data_exception) — confirmed by passing tests.
POST /rated-depth-acknowledge correctly 400s when reason is empty AND tabulated_data_exception=false (test_fv71_override_requires_reason passes).

POST /public/reinspection-request requires no auth and accepts all 7 directive reasons (Rain Event, Water Intrusion, Cave-In, Protective System Changed, Utility Conflict, Near Miss, Other) — parametrized test confirms (7/7 pass).

/oversight-chips returns all 12 expected keys with int values; /excavations?chip=<key> filter is consistent with the count for emergency (2 records ↔ 2 returned) and flag_protective (62 ↔ 62 returned).
/employees/competent-persons currently returns 1 designated CP in preview — minimal but functional.
EmployeePicker isCpMode path is wired (verified by reading source); not exercised in browser in this run because the form CP picker requires a job-selected workflow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (form + oversight page render with correct chips and counts; no JS errors)
